look_here_first: Check four sharp stem wings created by sessile leaf bases running down the stem; alternate lanceolate leaves and 4 yellow petals with 8 stamens confirm.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect, branching annual or short-lived wetland herb; strongly four-angled, winged stems.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, lanceolate or linear-lanceolate, usually sessile; leaf bases decurrent along stem.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Usually 4 bright yellow petals and 8 stamens; ovary inferior.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Obconic to narrowly pyramidal capsule, sharply 4-angled or winged.
